Subject A.A. Kooznetsoff and A.P. Fessanko, applicants to join the
S.M.P. Reserve Unit as drivers.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofeiv Forwarded by J Boyne D S I

1. Alexander Alexandrovitch KOOZNETSOFF, Russian, was
born on September 29, 1906 at Ivanovo-Voznessensk, Vladimir
District, Russia. Son of a military functionary who perished
during the revolution in 1918, he arrived in Shanghai from
Vladivostock via Genzan (Korea) with the Habarovsk Military
Cadets School in December, 1922 and has since been residing in
this city. Upon graduating from the school in 1924 he has been
working mostly as a chauffeur and for the past five years as
a chauffeur and bodyguard. He is a member of the Union of Former
Cadets of the Habarovsk Military School and is known to several
Russian members of the Municipal Police, his former schoolmates.
At present Kooznetsoff resides at 918 Avenue Joffre,
Apt. 7.

2. Alexey Petrovitch FESSENKO, Russian, was born on August 18,
1909 at Pogranichnaya Station, Chinese Eastern Railway, and resided
there until 1921 when he left for Vladivostock in order to enter
the Habarovsk Military Cadets School. Shortly prior to taking
control of Vladivostock by the "reds" in November, 1922, he
left that city together with the school and after a brief stay
in Genzan (Korea) and Mukden proceeded to Harbin to join his
mother and to continue his education.
Fessenko arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in August, 1925.
From 1927 to October 1928 he served with the Russian Detachment,
S.V.C., after which he worked for various periods with different
local firms as a supervisor and from 1933 as a radio mechanic
and salesman. He was absent to Harbin in 1934.
Upon leaving the Russian Detachment in 1928 he continued to
serve in the 3rd Russian (Volunteer) Company, S.V.C., until
January 4, 1936 when he was discharged for having repeatedly

由警探长 Prokofeiv 制作 经警探长 J Boyne 转呈

1. Alexander Alexandrovitch KOOZNETSOFF，俄国人，1906年9月29日出生于俄罗斯弗拉基米尔省伊万诺沃-沃兹涅先斯克（Ivanovo-Voznessensk）。其父为一名军事官员，在1918年革命期间身亡，他于1922年12月随哈巴罗夫斯克军校学员队从符拉迪沃斯托克经元山（朝鲜）抵达上海，此后一直居住在本市。1924年从该校毕业后，他主要从事司机工作，过去五年则担任司机兼保镖。他是哈巴罗夫斯克军校前学员联盟的成员，并为警务处数名俄国籍成员所知，这些人是他昔日的同学。目前 Kooznetsoff 居住在霞飞路918号7室。

2. Alexey Petrovitch FESSENKO，俄国人，1909年8月18日出生于中东铁路边境站（Pogranichnaya Station），并在此居住至1921年，随后前往符拉迪沃斯托克进入哈巴罗夫斯克军校学员队学习。在1922年11月“赤色分子”控制符拉迪沃斯托克前不久，他随该校离开该市，在元山（朝鲜）和沈阳短暂停留后，前往哈尔滨与母亲团聚并继续学业。
Fessenko 于1925年8月从哈尔滨抵达上海。1927年至1928年10月期间，他在商团义勇军俄国分队服役，此后在不同本地公司断续担任监工，自1933年起担任无线电机械师及推销员。1934年他曾前往哈尔滨。
1928年离开俄国分队后，他继续在商团义勇军第3俄国（志愿）连服役，直至1936年1月4日因屡次

Fessenko is married and has one child. At present he
resides at No. 153 R. Route des Soeurs, Apt. 37. His father,
who was an officer in the Russian Imperial Army, has been
missing since 1914 and his mother, Mrs. D.F. Fessenko, resides
in Harbin.
Both applicants are registered with the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, No. 118/1 Moulmein Road. They did not
come to the notice of the Municipal Police in connection with
any activities of an undesirable nature and enquiries do not
elicit any information which could reflect adversely on their
characters.
